Prithvi Commercial Bank 
 
 Guarantee & Bond Department 
 
 
 Performance Bank Guarantee 
 
 Non-Judicial Stamp Paper - Value: INR 100/- 
 
 Bond No: BND-00214 Issue Date: 2024-07-19
 
 IRREVOCABLE AND UNCONDITIONAL 
 
 To: 
 The Managing Director / Executive Director 
 
 The Employer / Commissioner 
 India 
 
 Subject: Performance Bank Guarantee for Performance Bond - Tender Ref: RFP-132022504
 
 Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
 WHEREAS National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (hereinafter called the "Contractor/Principal")
 has submitted a bid vide Tender Reference RFP-132022504 dated 2024-07-19 for the work of
 Roads Highways Works, and 
 
 WHEREAS as a condition precedent for the award of the contract, the Contractor is required to
 
 furnish a Performance Bank Guarantee for 5% (five percent) of the contract value, and
 WHEREAS the Contractor has requested Prithvi Commercial Bank (hereinafter called the
 
 "Guarantor") to issue this Performance Bank Guarantee in your favour. 
 
 NOW THEREFORE, we, Prithvi Commercial Bank, do hereby irrevocably and unconditionally
 guarantee to pay to you, on first written demand without protest or demur, an amount not
 
 exceeding INR 58.84 Lakh (Rupees 58.84 Lakh Only), being Performance Bond amount, subject
 to the following terms: 
 
 terms and conditions 
 
 1. Liability: Our total liability under this Bank Guarantee shall not exceed INR 58.84 Lakh
 
 (India Rupees Rupees 58.84 Lakh Only). 
 2. Validity: This Guarantee shall remain valid from 2024-07-19 until 2028-03-27 (the
 
 "Expiry Date") unless extended by mutual consent in writing. 
 3. Claim Period: We shall be liable to pay under this guarantee only if a written claim or
 
 demand is served upon us on or before the Expiry Date. 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-BOND-00214 Page 1 of 3

4. Enforceability: Any claim arising under this guarantee shall be enforceable at our
 branch office at Mumbai or at any scheduled bank branch in India as nominated by the
 claimant. 
 
 5. No Defence: Our obligation to pay is absolute and unconditional. We shall have no
 right of set-off, counterclaim, or defence arising from any dispute between the
 
 Contractor and the Employer. 
 6. Modification: This guarantee shall not be affected by any change in the constitution,
 
 ownership, or control of the Contractor or the Employer. 
 7. Governing Law: This guarantee is governed by the laws of India and is subject to the
 
 exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Mumbai. 
 
 Bank details 
 
 
 Guarantor Bank Prithvi Commercial Bank 
 
 Branch Corporate Branch, Mumbai 
 
 IFSC Code KNBX0004417 
 
 Bond Reference BND-00214 
 
 Status Active 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-BOND-00214 Page 2 of 3

authorised siGnatory - Guarantor 
 
 
 
 
 Authorised Officer 
 Prithvi Commercial Bank 
 Corporate Branch, Mumbai 
 
 Date: March 31, 2026 
 
 
 
 Acknowledgement by the Contractor 
 
 I/We, National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd., hereby acknowledge receipt of this Performance Bank
 Guarantee and confirm that the terms and conditions herein are acceptable.
 
 
 
 Director 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
 Date: March 31, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 Instructions to Bank (on expiry) 
 
 Bank should note that on expiry of the Bond Period, the Original Bond will not be returned to the Bank. The Bank is
 requested to take appropriate action on or after the expiry of the bond period. Any extension, if required, shall be
 communicated separately by the Guarantor. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-BOND-00214 Page 3 of 3
